Android USB driver packages

The original INF, catalog and required x64 coinstaller files are preserved without modification.
Each package retains the copyright and vendor terms stated in its INF.

Google USB Driver r13
Source: https://dl.google.com/android/repository/usb_driver_r13-windows.zip
DriverVer: 08/28/2014,11.0.0000.00000
Catalog publisher: Google LLC

OPLUS Android WinUSB driver
Source: original signed Windows DriverStore package
DriverVer: 01/04/2023,11.0.0000.00000
Catalog publisher: Microsoft Windows Hardware Compatibility Publisher

These packages supply Windows USB interface drivers. They are not tablet firmware.
